key_insight: CAP learns PPG representations by aligning waveform features with patient-level clinical context, not just signal patterns.
clinical_relevance: This could improve the robustness and transferability of wearable-based models for downstream health monitoring and clinical decision support.
method: Built a large paired PPG-EHR dataset by distilling fragmented records into patient-level EHRs.
Used cross-modal contrastive pretraining to anchor PPG embeddings to clinical semantics.
Applied the pretrained encoder to downstream tasks with stronger clinical inductive bias.
evidence_signal: In experiments across four downstream tasks, CAP outperformed strong baselines, with up to +87.6% relative improvement for respiratory rate prediction and +26.7% average relative gain overall.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on access to high-quality paired PPG-EHR data, so external validation and deployment in new cohorts will be important.
paper_title: CAP: Towards PPG Universal Representation Learning with Patient-level Supervision
